adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6` `save()` sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`, which can be `null` for a newly added host (no default is set anywhere; `categoryId` starts `null`). Server-side, `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` explicitly replaces blank `category_id` with `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. However, on success the client forcibly runs `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')));`, i.e. `findById(null)`, overwriting any hydrated/returned category. This would leave `host.category` empty until refresh, matching the finding.
